label: Lamassu-HNH system
definition: A Lamassu system in which an organism possesses a locus encoding an HNH-domain LmuA effector, a short-form SMC-like LmuB sensor, and LmuC.
observations: Short-LmuB HNH-bearing Lamassu architecture; computational genomic example only. The XML also accepts long LmuB; model keys are related, not exact synonyms. No HNH-specific experimental activity is asserted.
